decisions.reason: The GIS solution platform was promoted from a mention to a page of its own, and it underpins the firm's core project business. That makes it a strategic option worth holding at low marginal cost.

The mobile field data capture software kept its own page through 2019 and fits the firm's GIS portfolio. With no evidence of failure, keeping this still-uncertain option open is cheaper than giving it up.
The search extension was still being developed in 2019 (version 1.6.0) while weaker plugins were pruned. Surviving that pruning signals enough value to justify continued low-cost maintenance.
